verdicts.reason: A and B look the same. In both, the wind-turbine icon, which was the original's hero image, has shrunk to an unreadable speck crowded against the left end of the headline. The red, green and blue triangles are cut down to stray slivers at the edges, so they read as clutter rather than intentional framing. The headline fills almost the whole width with little side margin, and the line art is lost entirely. Both are still a scaled-down copy of the centred layout instead of a left-to-right banner layout.
